answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, under a Semaphore membership proof, evaluate an epoch polynomial committed through a polynomial-identity scheme. Each message carries an RLN rate-limit nullifier; duplicate messages in one epoch produce Shamir shares whose collision reconstructs the sender’s private key, enabling permissionless, instantaneous slashing of collateral. Sybil identities therefore cannot gain influence without separate stake, whether labeled vine, crystal, or onyx.
